lines: The Composer autoloader is optimized beyond level 1. The manual allows only config.optimize-autoloader: an authoritative class map breaks the upgrade of the app, and APCu is no required extension.

1 class implements or extends what the public API marks #[Consumable] in a major of Nextcloud 35: an app calls it, and the server may add a method to it in any release, which breaks a class that implements it.
lib/Db/Document.php:35 OCA\Text\Db\Document extends OCP\AppFramework\Db\SnowflakeAwareEntity

1 DAV plugin listens to propFind and not to preloadCollection, which the server emits from Nextcloud 32 on before it reads the children of a collection. Without that listener a PROPFIND with Depth above 0 runs the queries of the plugin once per child.
lib/DAV/WorkspacePlugin.php:58 OCA\Text\DAV\WorkspacePlugin

Nothing in the app calls 3 routes outside OCS. Looked for: a route name or a path in the PHP source and the templates, in 358 files of the frontend source and in the navigation of info.xml. A route stays behind when the frontend stops calling it. A route that only a client outside the app calls shows here as well, unless its method allows requests from other origins (CORS).

psalm/phar, phpunit/phpunit are in require-dev of composer.json. The manual recommends a vendor-bin/ of bamarni/composer-bin-plugin per tool, so that the dependencies of a tool cannot conflict with those of the app.
